prompt: Build ValueChain<T>, an immutable linked chain where each cell holds a value and the rest of the chain: implement of, prepend, length, valueAt and toList by walking the references.
explanation: A generic class can refer to itself: the field `ValueChain<T> rest` makes every cell hold a smaller chain of the same element type, which is how linked structures are typed without Object or casts. Because prepend returns `new ValueChain<>(value, this)` instead of mutating anything, the old chain stays valid and the two chains simply share a tail. Walking with a local `ValueChain<T> cell = this` and reassigning `cell = cell.rest` until it is null is the standard traversal for length, valueAt and toList.
hints: of(value) makes a cell whose rest is null; prepend(value) makes a cell whose rest is `this`.
To walk, declare a local variable starting at `this` and keep assigning it to cell.rest inside a while loop until it becomes null.
valueAt must guard index < 0 up front and simply fall out of the loop (returning null) when the chain runs out.
